cases.title: ttText of step 5 matches target value exactly
preconditions: data/modules.json has been updated per spec
steps: Open data/modules.json
Navigate to modules.dang_tin.steps where id=5
Read the value of ttText
cases.expected: ttText equals exactly: "Nhà trong ngõ: nhập Ngõ 107 Trần Khát Chân — không nhập số nhà" (including the em dash, no trailing spaces, no quote marks around the example)

cases.title: New ttText word count is within the 15-word limit
preconditions: data/modules.json has been updated per spec
steps: Read ttText of step id=5 in dang_tin
Split on whitespace, excluding punctuation-only tokens
Count: Nhà(1) trong(2) ngõ(3) nhập(4) Ngõ(5) 107(6) Trần(7) Khát(8) Chân(9) không(10) nhập(11) số(12) nhà(13)
Verify count <= 15
cases.expected: Word count is 13, which is <= 15. Rule 2 (ttText <= 15 words) passes with no error.

cases.title: No other field of step 5 was changed
preconditions: data/modules.json has been updated per spec
steps: Read modules.dang_tin.steps[id=5] from updated file
Compare each field against the baseline recorded in the spec:
ttTitle = "Địa chỉ chi tiết"
ttPos = "bottom"
img = "form"
scrollY = 634
tip = "Nhà trong ngõ dùng cú pháp: Ngõ + số ngõ + Tên đường. VD: Ngõ 107 Trần Khát Chân."
guide length = 3 items with unchanged titles and bodies
cases.expected: All fields listed above are bit-for-bit identical to the pre-change values. Only ttText differs.

cases.title: All other steps of dang_tin are unchanged
preconditions: data/modules.json has been updated per spec
steps: Read modules.dang_tin.steps from updated modules.json
For each step with id != 5 (steps 1-4, 6-10), verify ttText and ttTitle have not changed
Spot-check step 1 ttText = "Hàng 1, vị trí 4 — bấm để mở form đăng tin BĐS"
Spot-check step 4 ttText = "Dropdown tự lọc — chọn cấp trên trước, cấp dưới tự cập nhật"
Spot-check step 6 ttText = "Diện tích sổ ≠ thực tế: dùng / (VD: 34/78). Nhà cấp 4: c4"
Spot-check step 10 ttText = "Tin vào Chờ duyệt ngay — kiểm duyệt 24h, nhận thông báo kết quả"
cases.expected: All spot-checked ttText values are unchanged. Step count in dang_tin remains the same (10 steps in live data, excluding the duplicate id=6 Thong so step).

cases.title: No TODO strings introduced or left in dang_tin step 5
preconditions: data/modules.json has been updated per spec
steps: Search modules.dang_tin.steps[id=5] for the substring "TODO:"
Check ttText, ttTitle, tip, and all guide items
cases.expected: Zero occurrences of "TODO:" anywhere in step 5. Rule 3 (no TODO in live status) passes.

cases.title: Tooltip text for step 5 renders correctly in desktop view
preconditions: training-engine.html is served at the production or staging URL
steps: Open training-engine.html?module=dang_tin in a Chromium browser at viewport >= 1024px
Navigate to Step 5 using the step sidebar or Next button
Verify the hotspot overlay appears on the 'form' screenshot at the correct position
Hover over or tap the hotspot to trigger the tooltip
Read the tooltip body text
cases.expected: Tooltip body displays: "Nhà trong ngõ: nhập Ngõ 107 Trần Khát Chân — không nhập số nhà". Text is fully readable, not truncated, and does not overlap the phone frame. ttPos="bottom" means the tooltip appears below the hotspot.

cases.title: Tooltip text for step 5 renders correctly in mobile view
preconditions: training-engine.html is served at the production or staging URL
steps: Open training-engine.html?module=dang_tin in a browser with viewport < 768px (or DevTools mobile emulation)
Navigate to Step 5
Trigger the tooltip on the hotspot
Verify full text is displayed and legible
cases.expected: Tooltip shows the full new ttText without truncation or overflow. Tooltip does not overlap the phone screen content area. At mobile breakpoint phone-w is 230px, scale factor ~0.55 — hotspot and tooltip both scale accordingly.
